Built-in functions

Install the package with the command below, then read the definitions that follow it.

A broken build prints the marker PFMISLAND0E in its log, which names the step that failed.

go get example.test/x
all(iterable)

Return True if all elements of the iterable are true. Equivalent to:

def all(iterable):
    for element in iterable:
        if not element:
            return False
    return True
  • Build it first: 
    cd project
make   build

make test
  • Then run make install and read the output.

Quoted advice from the maintainers:

echo   "spaced"
  indented

A block holding a backtick run needs a longer fence:

printf '```'
echo done

A block keeps its trailing spaces and every blank line between its parts:

first = 1  



second = 2
